title: IUT Robotics Society Mega Quiz — Techathon Nationals & Rover Summit 2026
excerpt: Participating in the Mega Quiz competition segment of Techathon Nationals & Rover Summit 2026 organized by the IUT Robotics Society at the Islamic University of Technology campus.
author: Fazley Rabbi

body:
## Stepping onto the IUT Campus

On **10 July 2026**, I had the wonderful opportunity to participate in the prestigious **Mega Quiz** competition at the **Techathon Nationals and Rover Summit 2026**, proudly presented by the **IUT Robotics Society** at the Islamic University of Technology (IUT) campus in Gazipur.

Techathon Nationals brought together engineering students, robotics innovators, and tech minds from across Bangladesh for competitions, summits, and academic exchange.

## The Mega Quiz Experience

The Mega Quiz challenged participants across a diverse spectrum of technology, robotics, computing history, algorithmic problem solving, and science fundamentals. Competing in the grand IUT auditorium alongside brilliant minds from top universities was an intellectually stimulating and fast-paced experience.

## Exploring the Campus and Community Spirit

Visiting the iconic red-brick architecture and scenic grounds of IUT with close university friends and batchmates added to the excitement of the event. Between competition rounds and the summit inauguration ceremony, we had the chance to network with robotics teams, discuss engineering projects, and celebrate our shared passion for technology.

These photographs capture the grand inauguration ceremony in the IUT auditorium, speakers at the podium, and memorable moments with friends amidst the lush gardens and brick pathways of the IUT campus.


## Key Takeaways (কী শিখলাম)

- **Rapid Scientific Deduction:** Sharpened quick-fire analytical thinking and decision-making under strict countdown constraints during the national mega quiz.
- **Cross-Disciplinary Robotics & AI:** Explored the tight coupling between embedded hardware, sensor telemetry, autonomous rover navigation, and intelligent control systems.
- **Inter-University Networking:** Connected with passionate student innovators, robotics enthusiasts, and competitive tech minds from engineering campuses across Bangladesh.
